title: Keynote: Paul Graham, YCombinator
summary: Paul Graham's keynote at PyCon 2012, in which he talks about startup ideas and what kinds of companies are likely to matter in the future. He discusses ideas such as a better email client and a search engine for hackers, and argues for looking back at the present from the future.
why: HN commenters return to it as a worldview-shaping talk whose predictions about technology and startup ideas turned out to be prescient.

quote.text: It was the talk that brought about the biggest change in the way I think about the world, my ambitions.
